title: compile.ts: shape colorEffect (non-none) silently dropped — only alpha/blendMode tracked, full colorEffect object ignored for shapes
description:
File: packages/swf/src/compile.ts, lines 944-984 (colorEffectKey function) and lines 1865-1882 (shape isFirst placement).

Bug: The colorEffectKey for shape objects only tracks blendMode+alpha and alpha (lines 956-967). It does NOT track a shape's full colorEffect object (type: tint, advanced, brightness, etc.). So if a ShapeDisplayObject has colorEffect.type !== 'none', the key returns null — the same as a plain shape — and posChanged never fires when the color effect changes.

In the isFirst path (lines 1865-1882), the compiler correctly encodes colorEffect as a CXForm. But if a shape on a subsequent keyframe has a DIFFERENT colorEffect (or goes from tinted back to normal), posChanged is false and the new colorEffect is not applied.

Cross-check: SymbolInstance, TextDisplayObject, BitmapDisplayObject all serialize the full colorEffect via JSON.stringify(ce) (line 969), so they work correctly. ShapeDisplayObject is the only type not handled.

Additionally, sprite.ts line 493 only checks colorEffect for instance/text/bitmap types (the 'if type !== instance/text/bitmap return null' guard), so shapes with colorEffect are ALWAYS null in sprite.ts colorEffectKey too.

Fix:
1. In compile.ts colorEffectKey (line 956): if displayObj.type === 'shape' and it has a colorEffect with type !== 'none', serialize it via JSON.stringify, just like instances. Remove the current blendMode/alpha-only path or make colorEffect take priority.
2. Apply the same fix to sprite.ts lines 484-496.

Acceptance: Unit test where a two-keyframe shape layer goes from colorEffect={type:'tint',tintColor:'#ff0000',tintMultiplier:1} to no color effect — verify posChanged fires and a new PlaceObject2 (no cxform) is emitted on frame 2.
